newsitem.title: USA: Southwest to acquire Pinemont Bank.
newsitem.headline: Southwest to acquire Pinemont Bank.

text.p: Southwest Bancorporation of Texas Inc said Monday it has agreed to acquire privately-held Pinemont Bank, paying 0.625 of a share of Southwest common stock for each share of Pinemont stock and resulting in the issuance of about 1,775,000 shares of Southwest common stock on a fully- diluted basis.
Southwest stock was trading at $20 a share Monday afternoon.
Southwest Bank said that with the qcquisition, it will have $1.3 billion in assets, a loan limit of $16 million, and 16 branches.
Southwest had assets of $1.07 billion as of March 31. Pinemont had assets of $235 million.
The deal is subject o shareholder and regulatory apporvals. Southwest said it could not immediately say when the transaction will close.
